page.overview:
Who is Arcee?

As a miner bot, Arcee was part of the bots without a cog who were working in the Energon mines in Iacon City.

Watching the Iacon 5000 from the bleachers, Arcee cheered for the leader Sentinel Prime when he made his grand entrance, jumping to high-five him as he performed a flyby right above her seat. When the race began, she spotted two miners, Orion Pax and D-16 competing in the race and jubilantly shouted the news to her fellow miners in the audience.

Later, Arcee was present when an upgraded Orion Pax visited the miners to rally them into rising up against Sentinel Prime, who betrayed the Primes and secretly working with the Quintessons. She expressed doubt that the cogless miners would be able to do much against Sentinel and his army, but an inspiring speech from Orion convinced the miners including Arcee to take up arms and join the battle above. After Orion—now rechristened Optimus Prime—rejuvenated Cybertron's energon supply with the Matrix of Leadership and returned all the miners' transformation cogs, Arcee was among the crowd receiving their cogs, gaining a new pink visor among other physical changes.
